verdict.rationale: Homebrew's official manpage documents a first-party command, `brew analytics off`, that turns off its anonymous aggregate user-behaviour analytics. Its README confirms the analytics are anonymised usage data, so this opt-out directly addresses the story. Missing for 10: no documented environment-variable opt-out for scripted or agent workflows in the evidence, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that disabling stops all data collection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote:
`brew analytics off`

Turn Homebrew’s analytics off.
Control Homebrew's anonymous aggregate user behaviour analytics.
View anonymised install, build and operating system usage data at formulae.brew.sh/analytics.
